opening.argument: The video instructs viewers to pay BUSD and approve a Forsage registration, then ties making money to referral recruitment within an upline and team structure. The speaker explicitly says the account’s results are empty because nobody has been referred, urges viewers to join a team, and tells them to share their referral link to start making money. The activation of multiple levels reinforces that recruitment structure. These statements establish a recruitment-driven, multi-level matrix scheme: the earning pitch depends on bringing in participants, rather than merely completing a wallet or registration tutorial.
